function.name: lookup_customer_by_phone
function.description: Looks up a customer by phone number. Returns {found, customer, open_jobs[], last_call_summary}. ALWAYS call this first when a call connects — use the caller-id phone number. If found is true, greet the customer by first name and reference open jobs. If false, treat as a new customer.

phone.description: The caller's phone number from caller ID. Any format works — endpoint normalizes.
